title: Pin atomic JSON transactions to one directory inode
description: test/vectors/atomic_json.py validates the parent path before locking, then repeatedly reopens parent/lock/journal/staging/targets by pathname. A concurrent rename plus replacement or symlink swap after validation leaves the process holding the old lock while it prepares and replaces files in a different directory, defeating serialization and allowing writes outside the originally validated directory. Open an owned no-follow O_DIRECTORY descriptor, bind lock and all operations to that inode with dir_fd/openat-style calls (or revalidate identical dev+ino at every boundary), and add a deterministic directory-swap race regression.
